old: \caption[Simulink SNS library blocks and neuron implementation]{The core blocks of the SNS-Simscape library (top): the graded neuron and synapse, the spiking neuron, the Ia and Ib afferent encoders, and the activation dynamics block, each with its function summarized. The full library adds the synapse-sum junction, the diameter-specific BPA force blocks, and the biological muscle block. Below is a functional schematic of the non-spiking neuron implementation: synaptic, leak, and applied currents feed membrane integration, and a threshold, inverse-slope gain, and saturation produce the bounded drive output. The voltage is fed back to both current calculations. The generic BPA force block remains a placeholder. These implementation views do not establish quantitative knee regulation or a completed CAD-coupled Simscape Multibody model.}

old: \caption[Construction of the braided pneumatic actuator]{Construction represented by the proposed finite-element model. (A) Six idealized wall layers with contact interfaces, outward internal pressure, and a fixed cap end. Longitudinal symmetry permits in-plane expansion; at the transverse half-length boundary, axial displacement is fixed, or a movable boundary with an optional external load replaces transverse symmetry. (B) Illustrative exploded cutaway showing the fabric covering, rubber, and opposite-handed aramid reinforcement anchored at the cap. The plane callout identifies longitudinal symmetry; the rubber callout identifies retained material above it. The middle rubber layer is explicit in (A) but not separated in (B). Layer spacing and cap details are schematic. Not to scale.}
new: \caption[Construction of the braided pneumatic actuator]{Proposed layered BPA finite-element model, not to scale. (A) Wall layers, contact interfaces, internal pressure, and end constraints. Longitudinal symmetry permits in-plane expansion. At half length, impose axial symmetry, or replace it with axial motion and an optional load. (B) Illustrative exploded cutaway identifying the cap, wall materials, and longitudinal symmetry plane. Middle rubber is separated only in (A); cap details and layer spacing are schematic.}
